def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_investment = 250000
    end_year_value = 320000
    management_fee_rate = 0.04
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    profit = end_year_value - initial_investment
    management_fee = end_year_value * management_fee_rate
    incentive_fee = profit * incentive_fee_rate
    net_end_year_value = end_year_value - management_fee - incentive_fee
    annual_return = (
        (net_end_year_value - initial_investment) / initial_investment
    ) * 100
    answer = round(annual_return, 1)

    # return answer
    return answer
